translations.text: This now is the supply of water that the God of hosts promised as a comfort to us who dwell on earth.
He said that he wished that from now on in the world living waters should always flow from the bellies of those under the sky who truly believed in him.
There is little doubt that the wellspring of this water is in the kingdom of heaven: that is, the Holy Spirit.
From there the holy and chosen ones drew it. Afterwards those who obeyed God channelled it here to earth through holy books, in various ways, into the minds of men.
Some keep it, the stream of wisdom, within the enclosure of the mind and hold it back with their lips, so that it does not flow out and go to waste.
But the pool stays deep and still in a man's breast, through the Lord's grace.
Some let it run off in streams over the land. That is not a wise thing, if such clear water, loud and shallow, spreads out over the fields until it turns into a fen.
But draw water now to drink, now that the Lord has granted you that Gregory has brought the Lord's well to your doors.
Let whoever brought a sound jug here fill his vessel now, and come back again soon.
If any man here has brought a leaky jug to this stream, let him mend it carefully, so that he does not spill the clearest of waters or lose the drink of life.
